status: Illustrative planning assumptions, not sales, commitments, or validated willingness to pay

market.note: Historical national site-count benchmark. The 10% subset is a planning assumption for buyer fit and access, not an observed market. Excludes private schools and pediatric practices. Schools are billable sites; districts may buy multiple sites.

modelNotes: Year 1 begins when funded. No calendar-year revenue or existing traction is implied.

Average active paid sites in each half-year = (start sites + end sites) / 2. Growth is linear within each half-year and net of cancellations. Free feasibility-pilot sites are excluded from paid sites.
Revenue = average paid sites * annual site price * months / 12. ARR = year-end paid sites * annual site price, not recognized revenue.

COGS scales with average paid sites. Support is direct delivery cost; product development, sales, privacy review and administration are OPEX. Team labor is included in product and sales, with lean founder compensation, not five executive-market salaries.

Operating result = revenue - COGS - OPEX. Simplified cash assumes receipts and expenses in the same period. No tax, interest, depreciation, capex, deferred revenue, or working-capital timing. Actual procurement and collection delays could increase funding needs.
The first 18 months cost $546,000 before revenue. The $600,000 raise includes $54,000 reserve. Assumed receipts of $144,000 yield $198,000 cash at month 18.
Illustrative 90% annual site retention and $2,400 maximum acquisition cost are validation targets, not model-derived results. New sales must replace churn as well as reach net site targets.
